t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pay attention to the gnome colours; switch colours and spots on the gnomes hat between guesses.

vb_textbox.text: Firstly, try a couple of times to determine which side of gnomes has the higher side reward - typically the reward will come in batches on that side.  Once the basket hits 0, you can then move to the other side safely and continue your decisions on that side; swapping over every time this happens.
